detailed_description: The PDF Rotator lets you upload a PDF, preview page thumbnails, rotate individual pages left or right by 90 degrees, or apply 90, 180, or 270 degree rotation to all pages. It uses PDF.js for browser previews and pdf-lib to save a new PDF with the selected page rotations. You can reset all changes before saving, then download a rotated copy of the file. This is useful for fixing pages that appear sideways or upside down before sharing or printing. It does not analyze orientation automatically, provide keyboard shortcuts, or guarantee preservation of every advanced PDF feature.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and choose a PDF file from your device
Wait for page thumbnails to load in the browser
Use the left or right rotate buttons on a page to adjust it by 90 degrees
Use Rotate All to apply 90, 180, or 270 degrees to every page when needed
Click Reset All if you want to clear the pending rotations
Click Save Rotated PDF to download the updated copy
usage_examples: A researcher rotates upside-down pages in a scanned article before reading
An office worker fixes sideways receipt pages before archiving a PDF
A student rotates landscape pages in a class handout before printing
A team member corrects mixed page orientations in a shared PDF packet
